summary: Re-verified the production Vercel credit-pricing fix after the fresh import. All 8 targeted static/runtime regression tests passed, the fresh Node load completed without an applyGenerationSurcharges error, both pricing-helper global binding audits found no orphan calls, and the production frontend build exited 0.

The successful build still reports pre-existing React hook dependency warnings in MultiImageUpload.jsx and useStudioSessionBack.js, plus a 957.5 kB gzip main bundle warning; none affect this fix.

rca_of_the_issue: The production ReferenceError was caused by applyGenerationSurcharges being called in frontend/api/[...path].js without being destructured from ./lib/creditPricing.cjs. The current destructure binds it, the CJS module exports it, fresh Node loading no longer surfaces the error, and yarn build succeeds.
